Knobby Wednesday

Boulder, CO · North Boulder · Mountain bike

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Knobby Wednesday is a mountain bike group ride in Boulder, CO. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:30 pm from Boulder Valley Ranch. Pace: laid-back, aerobic 4/10, technical 3/10. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: laid-back, aerobic 4/10, technical 3/10. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @boulderbma the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Knobby Wednesday group ride

The Boulder Mountainbike Alliance's beginner-friendly weekly ride on smooth, non-technical trails. Coed and no-drop: the group stops at every intersection and waits. Good first trail ride.
